purpose: Codex ingestion input for a real-company Monitor/account universe while preserving SAMPLE BTX internal truth boundaries.

truth_rules.btx_internal_relationship: Must remain SAMPLE or public-inference until BTX internal evidence confirms it.
truth_rules.external_priority: Research priority only; never Account Attractiveness or external Top-100 rank.
truth_rules.override: BTX-provided PRISM/HubSpot/Paperless/customer-master evidence supersedes public inference.

relationship_states.BTX_CONFIRMED: Reserved for later BTX internal evidence. None asserted here.
relationship_states.PUBLICLY_EVIDENCED_RELATIONSHIP: Official BTX/BTX-business-unit source names the company in supplier/customer-specific context.
relationship_states.PUBLIC_INTERACTION_INFERENCE: Lower-confidence public interaction; none asserted in this first high-confidence pass.
relationship_states.NO_RELATIONSHIP_EVIDENCE: No BTX-specific public relationship evidence found.

codex_guardrails: Do not invent missing CIKs, tickers, aliases, facilities, newsroom URLs, IR URLs, or source-native IDs.
Do not convert public relationship evidence into BTX_CONFIRMED.
Do not create special-case code for Lockheed, Blue Origin, or any named account.
Do not modify Account Attractiveness based on research priority.
Map existing SAMPLE commercial scenarios to real accounts only through explicit deterministic mapping.
Retire synthetic identity placeholders only when an explicit real-account replacement mapping exists.
Keep public identity, public intelligence, and SAMPLE BTX commercial context separately labeled.
